name: What are the benefits of upgrading to composite decking during a deck replacement?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of upgrading to composite decking during a deck replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upgrading to composite decking offers several benefits, primarily low maintenance and enhanced durability compared to traditional wood. Composite decks resist rot, insect infestations, splintering, and fading, eliminating the need for regular staining, sealing, or painting. This results in significant time and cost savings over the deck's lifespan. While the initial material cost is often higher than wood, the reduced maintenance translates to a greater return on investment for many homeowners. Hometelligent Inc. offers various composite brands and styles to match your aesthetic preferences and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Composite decking offers low maintenance, durability, and resistance to rot and insects, saving time and money long-term despite higher initial costs.
